This offer will not valid for Gold Coin and Biscuit Purchases

The cardholder must inform the merchant of the preferred instalment tenure at the time of payment, and the transaction conversion must be completed at the merchant outlet at the point of payment.
data.terms_and_conditions:
1. This offer is valid only for Sampath Mastercard & Visa Credit Cardholders.

2. In order to enjoy the promotion, the full payment needs to be settled with a Sampath Mastercard or Visa Credit Card.

3. This offer is not valid for purchasing of Gift Vouchers & non-discountable items.

4. This offer cannot be combined with any other existing offers.

5. This offer will not valid for Gold Coin and Biscuit Purchases

6. The minimum bill value should exceed Rs. 5,000/- in order to be eligible for the promotion.

7. All instalment amounts paid are non-refundable and each instalment period of the payment plan as approved by the Bank may not be varied.

8. Once submitted, the details of the instalment plan requested above cannot be changed and part acceleration is not allowed.

9. The Bank accepts no responsibility in any way for any goods or services purchased and any dispute relating to same should be resolved by the Cardholder directly with the Partner and any claim by the Cardholder against the Partner will not relieve the Cardholder from his/her obligation or repayment to the Bank.

10. Spending made under above promotion will not qualify for the accumulation of Ultra Rewards Loyalty points.

11. The general Terms & Conditions of Sampath Bank PLC and Raja Jewellers (Pvt) Ltd shall apply.

12. In the event of any dispute, the decision of the Bank shall be final.

13. The Bank reserves the right to modify or change the Terms & Conditions of the offer.
